entries.description: National Houseplant Appreciation Day was created in 2012 by the Gardener’s Network to remind us to care for our houseplants during the winter months. entries.description: Photo Credit: NASA/JHUAPL/SwRI Pluto Day commemorates the discovered a tiny, distant planet on February 18, 1930 by astronomer Clyde W. Tombaugh. After other astronomers confirmed his finding, they publicly announced the discovery of Pluto on March 13, 1930. Back then, people hailed Pluto as the ninth planet. entries.description: National Ranch Dressing Day is a dedicated to America’s most popular salad dressing, a position held since 1992. The day celebrates ranch dressing, the creamy, tangy condiment used as a salad dressing and as a dip. It’s made with buttermilk, garlic, onion, mustard, herbs (commonly chives, parsley, and dill), and spices.
